mentions.name: Flickbook
mentions.description: This open-source tool lets people view code changes made by an AI agent step-by-step, helping them understand those changes.
mentions.problem: Understanding the code changes made by AI agents can be difficult.
mentions.audience: Junior engineers, especially those who need help understanding AI agent code changes
mentions.source_excerpt: I recently built an open-source project called Flickbook. I created this so people can view the code changes made by the AI agent step-by-step, which should help with understanding them.
